entries.name: Push-up
entries.summary: Three drawn positions of a push-up, seen from the side.

provenance.positions: Authored for this repository from its own curated execution instructions and coaching cues for movement_id 16 (packages/core-db/src/schema/010_movement_library.sql, 025_movement_coaching_content.sql).
instructionAgreement: top — "set one straight line from head to heels"; hips, shoulders and heels are drawn on one line in every frame.
descent — "Lower the chest as one unit"; the elbow stays behind the wrist, as the cue "Track the elbows behind the wrists" asks.
bottom — "if the hips and chest arrive separately, raise the hands"; the body line stays rigid at the bottom.
provenance.artwork: No third-party artwork. Every frame is a list of joint coordinates in this file, drawn at runtime from plain React Native views.
provenance.licence: Original work created for this repository; covered by the repository licence.

entries.reviewNotes: Side view only, hands fixed on the floor. Hand width, shoulder blade position and neck position are not visible from this angle. No qualified technique reviewer has signed this off yet.
entries.limitations: The drawing cannot show how far the elbows flare away from the ribs, which is the fault the cues care about most.

frames.caption: Top: one straight line from head to heels, arms long
Halfway down: the chest leads, elbows tracking behind the wrists
Bottom: chest close to the floor, hips and chest arriving together

entries.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the ankle planted on the drawn box at (20, 58) tilts the rigid line head-down (the feet 26 units above the floor) while the shoulder rides the arm circle (upper 12.5 / fore 12.0) from a 22-unit span to 12 at the bottom. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a feet-elevated push-up on a box....

frames.caption: Set your feet on the box and your hands on the floor just wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor as one rigid line.
Keep the hips locked into the plank at the bottom.
Press back to long arms without the hips piking.
Finish with the chest leading and the chin packed.

entries.name: Push Up to Side Plank
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the push-up chain (the rigid line and the arm circles) with the far arm opening from the floor to the ceiling across the last three positions - the far wrist travels 24.8 units while the near arm finishes the press. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a push-up that opens into a side plan

frames.caption: Set the pelvis in a braced push-up before the rep.
Lower through the push-up with the trunk braced.
Press the floor away without momentum.
Open the top arm as the press finishes.
Reach the top hand to the ceiling in one rigid line.
Return the hand to the floor with control.

entries.name: Push-Up Wide
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same rigid-line push-up chain with the elbow solve flipped to the flared side (the elbows ride above the wrist line instead of behind it), which is what a wide grip projects to in a side elevation. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a wide-grip push-up with flared elbo

frames.caption: Set the hands wide on the floor with the chest open.
Lower with the shoulder blades set and the elbows flared.
Stay wide through the bottom of the range.
Press through the same line every rep.
Finish tall with the wrists stacked over the press line.
